description.zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 拓展字段，按需传递，需要额外记录的房间属性。所有字段键-值长度总和不超过2048字节。
description.en: The extension field. Pass this parameter as needed to record additional room properties. The total length of all field key-value pairs cannot exceed 2048 bytes.

description.zh: 房间公告，支持中英文和数字以及常用符号，最大长度256个字符。
description.en: The room notice. Chinese characters, English characters, digits, and common symbols are supported. Maximum length: 256 characters.

description.zh: 房间ID，最大长度36个字符，传空值，则随机生成一个房间ID。
description.en: The room ID. Maximum length: 36 characters. If you leave this parameter empty, a room ID is randomly generated.

description.zh: 房主ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符。
description.en: The ID of the room owner. Only English characters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters.

description.zh:
模板ID。取值：

- **default**：默认。

传空值，则默认为**default**。
description.en:
The template ID. Valid values:

- **default**: the default template.

If you leave this parameter empty, the value **default** is used.

description.zh: 房间标题，支持中英文和数字，最大长度32个字符。
description.en: The room title. Chinese characters, English characters, and digits are supported. Maximum length: 32 characters.
